typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Account Number} as decimal(18,0),
		{Order Number} as string,
		IBX as string,
		{Unique Space ID} as string,
		{Order Status} as string,
		{Create Date} as date,
		{Order Closed Date} as date,
		{Customer Reference #} as string,
		{PO Number} as string,
		{Ordering Contact Name} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as string,
		UniqueSpaceID as string,
		PoNumber as string,
		OrderNumber as string,
		OrderingContactName as string,
		CreateDate as string,
		FName as string,
		AccountNumber as integer,
		EtlUser as string,
		OrderStatus as string,
		CustomerReference as string,
		IBX as string,
		OrderClosedDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		UniqueSpaceID = {Unique Space ID},
		PoNumber = {PO Number},
		OrderNumber = {Order Number},
		OrderingContactName = {Ordering Contact Name},
		CreateDate = {Create Date},
		FName,
		AccountNumber = {Account Number},
		EtlUser,
		OrderStatus = {Order Status},
		CustomerReference = {Customer Reference #},
		IBX,
		OrderClosedDate = {Order Closed Date}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
